feeds.title: TheHumanist.com
feeds.description: TheHumanist.com is the online publication of the American Humanist Association, providing daily news, opinion, and information. It applies humanism-a rational philosophy without theism or other supernatural beliefs that is informed by science, guided by reason, inspired by art, and motivated by compassion-to commentary on politics, science, technology, art, and culture. American Humanist Association advocates progressive values and equality for humanists, atheists and freethinkers.

feeds.title: American Humanist Association
feeds.description: The American Humanist Association has stood as the voice of humanism in the United States for over 80 years. We strive to bring about a progressive society where being good without a god is an accepted and respected way to live life. We are accomplishing this through our defense of civil liberties and secular governance, by our outreach to the growing number of people without traditional religious faith, and through a continued refinement and advancement of the humanist worldview.

feeds.title: Humanists International Blog
feeds.description: Humanists International is the world union of humanist organisations. Our vision is a humanist world; a world in which human rights are respected and everyone is able to live a life of dignity. Humanists International works to build and represent the global humanist movement that defends human rights and promotes humanist values worldwide.

feeds.title: New Humanist Blog
feeds.description: The latest and very best news, essays, blogs, links and information from New Humanist. New Humanist is the London based magazine of the Rationalist Association, promoting reason, debate and free thought since 1885. The Rationalist Association is a charity registered in the UK which promotes reason and evidence in the understanding of life, and a humanist outlook.

feeds.title: UU Humanist Association Blog
feeds.description: Find the latest news and updates by the members of the association on the UU Humanist Association Blog. The Unitarian Universalist Humanist Association supports Humanism among UUs and acts as a bridge to the secular world.

feeds.title: Humanists UK News
feeds.description: At Humanists UK, we want a tolerant world where rational thinking and kindness prevail. We work to support lasting change for a better society, championing ideas for the one life we have. Bringing non-religious people together to develop their own views and an understanding of the world around them.

feeds.title: British Columbia Humanist Association Blog
feeds.description: The BC Humanist Association is a provincial charity for those who seek to live ethical and fulfilling lives on the basis of reason and compassion.

feeds.title: Happiness Thru Humanism
feeds.description: Humanism is a highly effective approach to human development. Learn more with this blog. Short posts about the Humanist philosophy designed to encourage people to live ethical lives of personal fulfillment that aspire to the greater good of humanity.

feeds.title: Anders Bolling
feeds.description: Read writings from Anders Bolling on Medium. He is a recovering news journalist with a deep interest in society, science, spirituality & how they merge. Communicate and bridge. Explore intellectual musings that dive into big existing questions of today and take a deep look from a spiritual, humanist, grassroots perspective.

feeds.title: Humanist Heritage Canada Blog
feeds.description: Humanist Freedoms features essays, stories and news about contemporary applied humanism and our shared humanity. We focus on individuality, the bonds of friendship and humanist action that celebrates humanity, dignity and humanist rights and freedom.

feeds.title: Secular Humanists of Western Lake Erie Blog
feeds.description: Secular Humanists of Western Lake Erie (SHoWLE) provides a supportive, diverse, local community for humanists and other nontheists, while promoting ethical and reasonable secular world views through education, community service, outreach, activism, and social events.

feeds.title: Humanist World Blog
feeds.description: Writing about the human experience. Read blogs about humanist and its experience on humanist world blog.

feeds.title: Secular Hub Blog
feeds.description: A chapter of the American Humanist Association.

feeds.title: Humanist Society Scotland
feeds.description: Humanist Society Scotland is part of a UK, European and wider international movement of people and organisations. In Scotland, Humanist Society members have a clear vision of a secular Scotland, and the activities that Humanist Society Scotland can pursue to achieve that end.
